correctness.rationale: The known partial-matching formula can be completed to an optimal full matching at no extra cost because pairing unmatched cells subtracts 2|P_i cap Q_j|. After aligning labels, off-diagonal B_ij=P_i cap Q_j have finite perimeter. Coordinate quantiles E_ij(t) partition each off-diagonal block into nested fractions t|B_ij|, and row/column mass-balance identities preserve every equal cell volume at each t. The natural labels differ on measure (t-s)L for s<t; matching gives upper bounds and the triangle inequality with endpoint L forces d_V^1(R_s,R_t)=(t-s)L exactly. BV locality bounds intermediate interfaces by original interfaces plus at most m(m-1) plane cuts of section area <=diam(Omega)^(d-1), proving uniform finite perimeter. This is an analytic continuum construction. The checked checker.py simulates exact finite-grid matchings but does not prove the BV assertion.
residual_risks: Only finite m, equal positive cell volumes, bounded Euclidean Lipschitz domain; no energy-minimizing geodesic.
